context: Tests source recording, classification, scope assessment, evidence-first quoting and refusal to promote an out-of-scope tool.

checklist.name: README and metadata recorded
checklist.description: Records name, org acme-corp, MIT licence, TypeScript, version 4.2.0 and the primary URL

checklist.name: Duplicate check first
checklist.description: Searches REVIEWED.md and REFERENCE_INDEX.md before creating files

checklist.name: Slug follows convention
checklist.description: Uses acme-corp-ui-kit (author or org plus tool name)

checklist.name: Tags from the controlled list
checklist.description: Tags the tool with library and, if relevant, framework or sdk, from the classification guide

checklist.name: Scope assessed as out of scope
checklist.description: Concludes the tool has no meaningful connection to agent context and memory management

checklist.name: Reasoning explained
checklist.description: Gives a short reason for the out-of-scope ruling rather than a bare verdict

checklist.name: Logged as out of scope
checklist.description: REVIEWED.md records the scope-fit as out of scope

checklist.name: Performance claim marked as reported
checklist.description: Presents the 60% faster rendering claim as (as reported), sourced to the README

checklist.name: No capabilities inferred
checklist.description: Does not attribute features that the README does not describe

checklist.name: No vendoring
checklist.description: Does not run git submodule add

checklist.name: No ANALYSIS file created
checklist.description: Does not create an ANALYSIS-*.md file or offer to promote it as if in scope

checklist.name: User informed
checklist.description: Tells the user the tool was ruled out of scope and why
